selection_rule: Quality first. Select a fully source-reviewed eligible recipe with no material obligation/discovery loss, preferring repeated lower end-to-end candidate latency with observed lower or nonincreasing actual usage. Unknown billing/usage prevents a quota-saving claim. If no recipe is fully qualified, select the best bounded diagnosed recipe for diagnostic confirmation, keep its unresolved HOLD/FAIL and label all confirmation unqualified; do not suppress holdouts. Use one unchanged recipe/baseline in two held-out domains with two independent repetitions each, no tuning after content/results.
tie_breakers: available actual usage with unknowns preserved
baseline: competent researcher -> fresh same-family critic -> fresh same-family final reviser
confirmation_scope: same integrated obligations and frozen common inputs within each pair; independently repeated work without sharing sibling answers
